questions.text: Why include both “Use when…” and “Do not use for…” in a tool description?

options.A: To make the description replace the argument schema.
options.B: To grant the tool permission to act without host checks.
options.C: To guarantee the model always selects that tool.
options.D: To distinguish intended use from similar but unsuitable cases.

questions.explanation: Positive usage guidance identifies suitable requests, while exclusions disambiguate nearby tools and use cases.

questions.text: A units parameter accepts only celsius or fahrenheit. Which schema best expresses this closed set?
questions.explanation: A string enum explicitly restricts the parameter to the two accepted values.

questions.text: lint_registry iterates over names and appends a duplicate-name finding whenever names.count(n)>1. If two otherwise valid tools share the same name, how many duplicate-name findings does it append?

options.A: Zero, because the later tool overwrites the earlier one.
options.B: One, because repeated names are deduplicated first.
options.C: Two, because each occurrence triggers the condition.
options.D: Four, because it compares every tool against every tool.

questions.explanation: The loop visits both occurrences, and names.count(n) is 2 each time, so it appends two findings.
